expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full DocumentsTable component with all required state, API calls, and subcomponents

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Complete runnable React component with full hook logic and event handling

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Archive has undo via undoExpiresAt. Delete has only typing confirmation: 'if (action === "archive" && result.undoExpiresAt)' indicates no undo for delete, only confirmation dialog protection

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: DeleteDialog prompts 'Delete {count.toLocaleString()} document...' and requires typing 'DELETE ${count}'

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: SelectionState discriminated: mode 'ids' vs 'allMatching'. Explicit selectAllMatching() function and separate UI messages for each state

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive: bg-slate-900 (filled). Delete: text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 (outlined). Visually distinct

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Cancel button has autoFocus in DeleteDialog, not delete button. Archive is primary action in bar, delete is secondary

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: 'the API should enforce authorization, query scoping, and `expectedTotal` atomically'

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Closes with enforcement note about idempotency and query scoping but does not enumerate specific prevented misuse scenarios
